decisions.decision: M2 measurement run retroactively via static manifest analysis (swift package dump-package against Xcode's own already-resolved checkouts) instead of a live resolve/build sweep
decisions.rationale: Genuinely report-only, no network/build cost, and the actual resolution-incompatible detection machinery is Phase 8's own deliverable -- can't use it to measure the gate that precedes building it

decisions.decision: M4 found moot by direct code inspection rather than run: BuildPipeline#seed_host_graph already classifies vendored_xcodeproj? checkouts as not-graph-pinned and skips seeding unconditionally, before any build -- nothing is ever claimed pinned on that path, so there is nothing for Phase 8 to detect drift against
decisions.rationale: Phase 7 took the conservative branch of M4's conditional preemptively; re-litigating it in Phase 8 discuss would be re-deriving an already-settled answer

decisions.decision: Single consolidated drift/provenance insertion point in BuildPipeline.run (right after perform_build succeeds), not duplicated across the three artifact-producing paths
decisions.rationale: Simpler, DRYer, and makes the Class-E (copy_prebuilt_binary_target) path get a correct provenance sidecar for free

decisions.decision: Fidelity status line printed from inside BuildPipeline.run rather than changing its return contract to a richer struct
decisions.rationale: Avoids an unrelated forced edit to command/pkg/build.rb, which treats the return value as a bare path string

context_notes: This was a very long, deep single-turn session: Phase 7 verification+code-review+fix (including catching a fixer agent that crashed mid-run and left an incomplete/wrong-test-asserting fix, corrected via re-review) + full Phase 8 discuss/research/measure/plan/check, all before any Phase 8 code was written.
